description: This Swift file defines a VoiceWakeManager class responsible for voice wake word detection and speech recognition, with utility functions for handling audio buffers, managing permissions, and coordinating the recognition process within an iOS app.

classes.name: AudioBufferQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue for managing AVAudioPCMBuffer objects, supporting enqueue, drain, and clear operations.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: A class that manages voice wake word detection and speech recognition using AVFoundation and Speech frameworks, handling permissions, audio session setup, and recognition lifecycle.

methods.name: makeAudioTapEnqueueCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback to enqueue incoming audio buffers into an AudioBufferQueue.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an AVAudioPCMBuffer by copying its channel data.

methods.name: configureAudioSession
methods.description: Configures the AVAudioSession for recording and playback with appropriate options.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Sets up and starts the speech recognition process, including audio engine tap installation.

methods.name: tearDownRecognitionPipeline
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the recognition pipeline and audio session.

methods.name: makeRecognitionResultHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler for processing recognition results and errors.

methods.name: handleRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Handles recognition results and triggers commands when wake words are detected.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts trigger commands from recognized speech based on configured trigger words.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the callback to invoke when a command is recognized.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the voice wake feature, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: setSuppressedByTalk
methods.description: Suspends or resumes recognition based on external talk suppression.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the voice wake recognition process with permission requests and setup.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recognition process and disables voice wake.

methods.name: suspendForExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Temporarily suspends recognition to allow external audio capture.

methods.name: resumeAfterExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Resumes recognition after external audio capture is finished.
